name.description: A display name; accounts have none yet.

Agent.description:
What the caller may know about an agent: everyone holding any capability on it sees it,
with their own capabilities; administrators see every agent with every capability.

activity.description:
`working`, `dreaming` or `idle` while running, otherwise the desired state such as
`sleeping`. Dreaming needs a run whose sandbox still holds its credential.

capabilities.description:
The caller's capabilities on this agent and its conversation as grant names, such as
`conversation_send`.

desktop_active.description: A running turn called a desktop tool in the last 120 seconds.

dreaming_model.description: The dreaming model on the agent's connection; `None` inherits the connection's model.

idle_delay_seconds.description: Seconds an idle agent waits before it dreams.

last_sequence.description: The highest turn sequence in the agent's conversation, 0 without turns.

pending_login.description: The agent is waiting for a person to log in on a site (ADR 0039).

read_sequence.description: The caller's read cursor in that conversation, 0 until set.

task_lanes.description: Delegated tasks that may run beside the main lane (ADR 0005), one to four.

runtime_available.description: Identity admission eligibility only, never authority to execute a turn.

Avatar.description: The agent's cube (docs/design/console.md); mood is derived from activity, never stored.

awaited.description: The parent yields until this child settles.

context_window.description:
Model window in tokens. Required for OpenAI, which cannot report it; Anthropic
reports its own when this is absent.

oneOf.description:
Left out, the agent gets the default cube. Absent from the command digest when `None`,
so receipts recorded before avatars still replay.

webhook.description: Makes a webhook secret, returned once.

secret.description: The webhook's bearer secret, only in the response that made it.

reason.description: Returned to the agent; empty when the person gave none.

DreamRevision.description: A revision the run committed, with the content it replaced.

previous.description: `None` for a memory the run created.

report.description: The model's account of the run; the committed revisions are the evidence.

DreamSkill.description: A skill revision the run published, with its `SKILL.md` and the one it replaced.

previous.description: `None` for a skill the run created.

FileAccess.description: `write` adds uploading, moving, renaming and deleting to `read`; `manage` adds sharing.

FileEntry.description:
A shared file or folder (ADRs 0059 and 0060), as the console and `/api/runtime/files` list
it. Uploads stream the raw bytes in the request body.

access.description: What the caller may do with it.

folder.description: A folder has no size, digest or content type.

owner_agent.description: The agent that owns it, when an agent does.

owner_user.description: The person who owns it, when a person does.

parent.description: The folder holding it; its owner's top level when absent.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex of the stored bytes' SHA-256, computed by the orchestrator.

FileShare.description:
A share of a file, and for a folder everything under it, with a person by login, a team or an
agent by name. `POST /api/runtime/files/{id}/shares` adds or changes one; a refusal is 400
with the reason the model reads.

Image.description: The raw bytes of a JPEG or PNG; a schema only, the handlers take `Bytes`.

InstalledSkill.description: An agent's installation, with the library's current revision to show available updates.

token.description: Revealed only on issuance. A retried command returns its durable ID.

Liveness.description: Process liveness only; this does not attest to dependency or agent readiness.

reason.description: The agent's words: untrusted text to show, never markup.

source_dream.description: The dream run that wrote the current revision.

source_turn.description: The turn whose completion wrote the current revision; `None` for a human edit or dream.

MemoryChange.description:
A memory write staged by the agent. A revision or removal names the revision it read; a
newer one, such as a human edit, wins and the change is dropped.

Occurrence.description: One occurrence that made a turn: its origin and the turn's outcome so far.

name.description: The room's or routine's name, or the sending agent's.

oneOf.description: A computer-use call that returns the screen; `image` is a base64 PNG (ADR 0085).

Placement.description: A new folder, or where a file goes: `parent` null or absent is the owner's top level.

name.description: The tool's name, such as `bash` or `delegate`.

reobserved.description: The agent's first screenshot after a person handed its desktop back.

Ran.description: A run's turn, or `None` when it coalesced into a pending one.

last_sequence.description: The newest message's sequence, 0 without messages.

manage.description: The viewer may change the members.

read_sequence.description: The viewer's read cursor, 0 until set.

RoomMembers.description: The room's whole new member set; putting the same set again changes nothing.

note.description: The coordinator's question, the continued task's agent, or the failure reason.

routing.description:
`routing` until the coordinator settles it as `routed`, `continued`, `clarify`,
`no_action` or `failed`; mentioned messages are `routed` at once.

managed_by.description: `person` or `agent`: an agent changes only the routines it manages.

webhook.description: A webhook secret is set; it is shown only when made.

SaveRoutine.description: What a routine does and when. At least one of `prompt` and `command`.

coalesce.description: At most one pending turn while one is queued or running.

enabled.description: A disabled routine runs only by hand.

schedule.description: Five-field cron in UTC; `null` runs only by hand or webhook.

oneOf.description: Installation items only: all agents when absent on create, unchanged on update.

agent.description:
On create, the agent whose own item this is; an installation item when absent. An update
keeps the item's scope.

secret.description: Required on create; an update without it keeps the current secret.

Skill.description: A library entry at its current revision.

dream_run.description: The dream run that proposed this revision.

human.description: The person who wrote this revision, or `None` for a dream's.

incorporated.description: The instruction entered the running context; not proof the agent followed it.

propagated.description: Copied from steering of the work that delegated this.

children.description: Work this turn delegated or sent to other agents.

oneOf.description: Where the request came from when a person did not send it here directly.
Replaces the earlier context for later model requests; the source history remains.
A steering message entered the context.
Memory changes staged during the turn commit with it, or not at all.
`None` keeps the current cube; not part of the revision history.

task_lanes.description: Concurrent delegated tasks, one to four; `None` keeps the current setting.

agent.description: The agent whose own item this is; an installation item when absent.
